concepts.name: Counseling Frontend SPA
concepts.summary: React 19 + TypeScript application for askers and consultants: registration wizard, login, Matrix messaging, calls, notifications timeline, profile and legal flows. Webpack build (config/webpack) with Vite/Vitest for tests, Storybook component tests, and Playwright smoke suites; React Router v7 and MUI/M3 theming.

concepts.name: Matrix-only Real-time Communication
concepts.summary: All messaging runs over Matrix (matrix-js-sdk). matrixClientService owns the client lifecycle, chatTransportService is the send/receive facade, matrixLiveEventBridge feeds live updates into the UI. RocketChat and Jitsi are fully removed; guard tests (matrixOnlyLegacyArtifacts, matrixCredentialBoundary, legacyAppointmentProviderAbsence) fail the build if legacy tokens reappear.

concepts.name: Application Structure
concepts.summary: src is organized into api (127 HTTP client modules incl. generated OpenAPI clients), components (per-feature folders such as message, registration, notificationsCenter, erstantwort), containers, services (Matrix/call/draft services), globalState, hooks, emails, and resources/i18n with bundled catalogues for de, de@informal, en, fr, ru, ti, tr.

concepts.name: E2EE and Silent Key Backup (Tresor)
concepts.summary: Matrix E2EE is durably on. Per ADR-019 the recovery key backup is set up silently at login instead of via a setup modal: matrixKeyBackupService creates the owner-bound backup, pendingRecoveryKeyStore holds keys until confirmed, device dehydration and room-history key transfer cover new devices, and KeyBackupRecoveryPrompt only appears when recovery is actually needed.

concepts.name: Calls: Element Call Widget and LiveKit
concepts.summary: Video/audio calls use Element Call embedded in widget mode (ADR-018 'Matryoshka') over LiveKit SFU. CallManager orchestrates call state, matrixCallService/matrixGroupCallService handle Matrix signalling, useElementCallWidget hosts the embed, and a generated theme (npm run generate:call-theme) restyles Element Call to ORISO design tokens. Legacy Jitsi appointment routes survive only as redirect stubs.

concepts.name: Notifications Center / Activity Timeline (Zeitstrahl)
concepts.summary: The notifications center renders an activity timeline of event notifications with Matrix-hydrated conversation previews. Event types come from an eventDescriptors registry; previews are gated fail-closed by case-handover consent (caseHandoverPreviewGate) so consultants without consent never see message content. Backed by apiEventNotifications, active-view PATCH, and do-not-disturb settings.

concepts.name: Registration and Onboarding Wizard
concepts.summary: Multi-step registration wizard (welcome screen, topic/agency selection, zipcode, demographics, account data) with a free-navigation stepper, preselection drawers, validation modules, and auto-login into the first enquiry. The redesigned login stage adds tenant-selectable effects (lamp-map) and a security explainer; a product tour (intro.js-based ProductTourAdapter with tutorial-progress API) onboards consultants.

concepts.name: Erstantwort and Anonymous (Carimat) Chat
concepts.summary: First-response (Erstantwort) sequence for new enquiries: templated message catalogue, deadline ownership rules, save-credentials card, and an email overlay. The anonymous/pseudonym surface (Carimat) adds consent gating, bot message animations, breathing tutorial cards, animal avatars from the shared anonymous-name engine, and queue-leave dialogs.

concepts.name: Legal, DPA (AVV) and Consent Surfaces
concepts.summary: Legal/compliance UI: DPA (data processing agreement) signature flow with DpaSign and signature API, department-specific legal texts (DepartmentLegalSection, per ADR/issue #555 department selector), legal content pages and link components, terms-and-conditions, and the case-handover consent cards built on the shared ButtonGroup.

concepts.name: Media Upload and Attachments
concepts.summary: Attachments upload to the Matrix media repo (apiMatrixUpload) and send as encrypted Matrix attachment messages. mediaUploadHelpers and resolveAttachmentForSend validate type/size before send, matrixEncryptedAttachment handles encrypt/decrypt, and AttachmentCard/MessageAttachment render download cards with media checks in the timeline.

concepts.name: Case Handover
concepts.summary: Consent-based case handover between consultants: client-facing consent cards, handover notices rendered as chat system messages, i18n aligned with ADR-002, and downstream gating of timeline previews. The consent decision also controls what the receiving consultant may see.

concepts.name: Transactional E-Mail Design System
concepts.summary: src/emails is a token-based e-mail design system (atoms/molecules/organisms/templates) with content catalogues for de-du, de-sie and en dialects. vite-node build scripts render templates for Keycloak and the MailService; Storybook 'Email/*' stories preview them and tests check e-mail client compatibility and dialect consistency.

concepts.name: Consultant Statistics View
concepts.summary: Consultant statistics page in the profile area (enquiries, messages sent, appointments, CSV export via react-csv) backed by the UserService statistics endpoint; messages-sent counting is privacy-scoped server-side.

flows.name: Asker Registration → First Chat
flows.summary: Asker walks the registration wizard (topic/agency selection, zipcode, account data) → apiPostRegistration creates the account → autoLogin authenticates against Keycloak and registers/logs into Matrix → the enquiry is sent (encrypted payload) → the session's Matrix room opens in the messaging UI.

flows.name: Encrypted Message Send
flows.summary: TipTap-based composer builds the message → attachments resolve through resolveAttachmentForSend and upload via apiMatrixUpload → chatTransportService sends the (Megolm-encrypted) Matrix event → matrixLiveEventBridge delivers the echo → MessageItemComponent renders it in the timeline with three-state delivery status; failures surface as FailedSendTimelineEntry, drafts persist via draftStore.

flows.name: Silent Key Backup Setup
flows.summary: After login the Matrix crypto stack initialises → matrixKeyBackupService silently creates or connects the key backup (owner-bound setup lock, no user dialog per ADR-019) → the recovery key is parked in pendingRecoveryKeyStore → the user is only prompted (KeyBackupRecoveryPrompt) if history cannot be decrypted on a fresh device.

flows.name: Call Invite → Element Call Join
flows.summary: A call invite arrives over Matrix → IncomingVideoCall surfaces it → CallManager coordinates accept/decline and room state → the Element Call widget (useElementCallWidget, matrix-widget-api) is embedded with the generated ORISO theme → media flows E2EE via LiveKit; group calls go through matrixGroupCallService.
